text: Current account-color tests temporarily disable dom.forms.html_color_picker.enabled, with bug2007435 explaining that adapting to the new picker is still pending. They use MockColorPicker and verify account tree, folder pane, and compose identity color/reset. Passing those tests would not prove the new HTML picker route. Retain the preference push cleanup and honest native UI boundary when reusing this harness. Tests were read, not run.
title: State which native color picker a test actually covers
